shipped_cases_missing.why: The run's project has no cases.json, so there are no shipped cases to explore. Nothing was admitted; the run reports that this profile has nothing to explore.

shipped_cases_invalid.why: The project's cases.json is not a version 1 file of this template with a non-empty list of cases, each with a unique id, text fields and changes that have a path, a value type and an old and a new value. Nothing was admitted.

shipped_cases_changed.why: The project's cases.json, or a price series a case names, differs from what was approved. The approval covers the whole file and those series, so the run stops until it is approved again.

shipped_series_unverified.why: The template's price series do not check against their meta.json hashes (missing meta.json or hash, a missing, extra or changed file), so no shipped case is admitted.

shipped_cases_over_budget.why: More shipped cases can run than the solve budget allows, or the pick has none or too many. The card asks the user to pick which cases to run; the first few are never taken.

shipped_case_not_runnable.why: A pick named a case that is not in the file or is not run (a change outside what a case may change). Nothing was admitted.
